title: The Philosopher's Stone
summary: A wise philosopher had four noble sons. He sent them to the four winds to discover the legendary Philosopher's Stone that could turn all things into gold....
full_text:
A wise philosopher had four noble sons. He sent them to the four winds to discover the legendary Philosopher's Stone that could turn all things into gold.

The first son brought back gold; the second brought back power; the third brought back fame.

The youngest son brought back an innocent heart, a love of truth, and hands dedicated to helping the poor. The dying philosopher embraced the youngest: "You have found the true stone of wisdom! Love and virtue alone turn the dross of mortal life into the pure gold of eternity."
moral: The true philosopher's stone is found not in chemical gold, but in the harmony of truth, goodness, and beauty.
